biggest_catch: Trend (trend.io) is a curated, brand-facing network: the official site publishes zero creator pay figures — hiring costs are expressed in brand-side 'credits' (20/40/60 by creator level), which is what brands pay, not what creators receive.
catches: Trend vets every creator before admission ('Trend vets every creator before putting them on our platform') — a 15K+ creator waitlist exists, so joining is gated.
Official pages state no per-gig creator rate, range, or minimum; pay is set per campaign between brand and creator.
The credit costs visible on official/API materials (20, 40, 60 credits by level) are brand-side hiring costs, not creator payouts.
The catalog's $200 claim has no official source — Trend's own materials never state a creator dollar figure.

c1.evidence: No concrete creator pay figure (no per-video rate, range, or minimum) found on any official Trend page (trend.io).

c2.evidence: Trend.io is the official domain (UGC platform and creator network); official pages describe a curated brand-facing marketplace without creator pay figures.

c3.evidence: No upfront creator fee stated on official pages; joining mechanics are waitlist/vetting-based.

c4.evidence: No creator payout timing published on official pages.

eligibility: Curated network — creators are vetted before admission; 15K+ on waitlist per official site. US-based iPhone users per third-party descriptions (not confirmed on official pages — treated as unverified).
notes: REJECT is a verifiability verdict, not a scam flag: Trend is a real UGC network (18,500+ videos created per its site), but the strict checklist requires a concrete payout in official terms and none exists. Do not list this route as verified. Note: 'Trend by Soona' branding appears in third-party coverage; the official trend.io site is the source used. Re-check if Trend publishes creator gig rates.
